name: GST and Business Activity Statement
cite: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999; TAA 1953 Sch 1

registration.note: Ride-sourcing and taxi travel must register for GST from the first dollar, regardless of turnover.

reporting_cycles.note: Voluntarily registered entities below the threshold may elect annual reporting.

due_date_note: If a due date falls on a weekend or public holiday, it moves to the next business day. Agent concession dates apply only where the client is on the agent's lodgment program.

labels.W1: Total salary, wages and other payments
labels.W2: Amounts withheld from salary and wages

gst_free_categories.note: Basic food is GST-free, but prepared food, restaurant meals, confectionery, savoury snacks, bakery products and most beverages are taxable. The food list is long and counterintuitive.
Goods must be exported within 60 days of the earlier of receiving consideration or issuing an invoice.
Requires a written agreement that the supply is of a going concern.

input_taxed_categories.note: No GST charged and generally no input tax credits. Watch the financial acquisitions threshold.
New residential premises are an exception and are taxable.

credit_denial_rules.rule: No input tax credit without a valid tax invoice for purchases over $82.50 including GST.
No credit for the private-use portion of an acquisition. Apportion.
No credit for acquisitions relating to input-taxed supplies.
No credit for entertainment expenses to the extent the expense is non-deductible under Div 32 ITAA 1997.
Input tax credits expire 4 years after the due date of the BAS in which they could first have been claimed.

under_1000: GST amount or a statement that the total includes GST

payg_instalments.note: The ATO enters you into PAYG instalments automatically based on your last assessed return. Varying an instalment downward and underestimating by more than 15% attracts the general interest charge.
